title: Expand global, Korean, India, and paper source discovery origins
measurement_note: The task began with web search before exact timing was started, so phase boundaries are approximate but explicit.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Collected global, Korean, India, and paper discovery sources through broad web search and direct page checks.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran memory bootstrap and selected governance mode.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.bottleneck_notes: Reviewed existing requirements and created source-discovery expansion spec artifacts.

phases.label: Registry and documentation updates
phases.bottleneck_notes: Expanded JSON registries, source lists, research README, web-search record, research note, request summary, trace, and work summary.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran JSON, config contract, memory bootstrap, docs, naming, structure, workspace index, workspace health, grounding, and diff checks.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.bottleneck_notes: Saved grounding/evaluator input and produced final evaluation report with no blocking gaps.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed after validation and evaluation records were prepared.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The longest visible phase is source discovery because the request explicitly asked for broader search-origin collection.
improvement_candidates: Use the expanded source registry as a seed next time to reduce repeated broad source discovery.
Consider a deterministic source freshness checker later if source expansion becomes repetitive.
